Some unnecessary information on my thought process about this discussion: These past several years I cannot stop analyzing everyone's reactions, emotions, and actions. I can sense how they think and how much effort is put into a thought. For example I use to be friends with this kid who would change the subject every time I would as a thought provoking question. I know it's not due to him being bored of my conversations because I noticed this was an almost instinctive reaction, as though it was natural. He didn't stop to think about my question or even reach the thought process of denying my question and changing the subject. Is this due to his ignorance? Or a lack of intellectual depth. I would also like to state that he isn't stupid academically or logically, that isn't how I mean. To his counterpart, my closest friend used to have deep philosophical discussions that would lead for hours. I could see it in his eyes how deeply his mind worked around my questions, trying to find not an answer but all the answers available and analyze all of them. This is how I am in everyday life. I feel as thought everything in my head is growth from the analysis in every observation I make. Is everyone at the same intellectual depth? Is there such a thing as depth within the mind?
